Frigomat operates as a private company originally established in 1969 by Alberto Cipelletti in Guardamiglio, Italy, where it still concentrates its main machinery manufacturing operations.
In January 2025, the Cipelletti family consolidated corporate ownership to 100% of the company's share capital by purchasing the 50% co-controlling stake previously held by the Soffientini family.
The Soffientini family's initial capital injection and 24-year investment period began in 2001 to assist Frigomat through a deep restructuring phase following an operational crisis.

Following the 2025 buy-out advised by Pirola Corporate Finance, the Cipelletti family announced intentions to leverage its full ownership to pursue capital growth opportunities, focusing heavily on expanding the brand's presence in the U.S. market.
The company functions as an independent family-owned entity with a registered workforce of 74 employees as of its recent corporate profile.
